text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Crown prince holds talks on ensuring stability and development in Bahrain.
- Bahrain Chamber of Commerce organises a lecture on the World Trade Organisation.
- Bahrain Monetary Agency governor says Bahrain has taken several steps to boost the country's financial position.
- Bahrain's new frigate to arrive in the island on July 8.
- Bahrain share index reaches 1647.05 points on Monday, the highest in 10 years.
- Information minister attends an Arab tourism meeting in Cairo.
- Foreign minister leaves for Syria on Tuesday to attend a meeting of foreign ministers of the Damascus Declaration.
